MERITUS are recruiting for a Cyber Security Engineer to join our client on an initial 24 month contract to support defence programmes as they hit their critical stages.

The role will involve technical activity across a range of security platforms and technologies, including but not limited to:

  • SIEM (Security Information and Event Management)
  • Network Packet Capture platforms
  • Anti-malware and malicious-code protection
  • Threat detection technologies
  • Security monitoring and analysis platforms

Core responsibilities include:

  • Maintain accurate mapping and topology of SOC toolsets, including integrations, connections and data feeds between solutions.
  • Improve the visibility and optimisation of SOC tools through data modelling, configuration and tuning.
  • Maintain core SOC toolsets, ensuring their availability, functionality and optimisation.
  • Monitor the availability and operational readiness of cyber security technologies across in-scope environments.
  • Track product lifecycles and advise management on End-of-Life (EOL) and End-of-Support (EOS) roadmaps.
  • Support the planning, coordination and execution of SOC appliance upgrades.
  • Support the implementation of new cyber security capabilities and their integration with existing solutions.
  • Implement security-tool configuration changes and ensure appropriate reporting through Change Advisory Boards (CABs) and control boards.
  • Lead playbook scripting activities, ensuring scripts are appropriately documented and tested.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot false positives and other technical issues affecting security detection.
  • Act as a technical subject matter expert for SOC connectivity and network visibility, ensuring integrations and connections are understood and documented.

Required Skills & Experience

The successful candidate should have experience across a broad range of cyber security engineering and infrastructure technologies, including:

  • Strong coding and scripting skills, particularly PowerShell, Python and Regex.
  • Experience working with APIs, including HTTP/S headers and responses and JSON objects.
  • Experience with proxy administration and configuration changes.
  • Knowledge of Windows (SMB) and Unix/Linux (*Nix) remote storage, including NFS.
  • Experience configuring IIS (Windows Web Server).
  • Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP authentication.
  • Experience applying certificates, software updates and patches, including activities associated with technology refresh and end-of-life replacement.
  • Experience with VMware and/or Hyper-V virtual machines and virtual switches.
  • Experience implementing, configuring and maintaining cyber security tooling.
  • Experience creating, testing and maintaining AI or machine-learning technologies to optimise workflows or security playbooks.
  • Experience with SIEM technologies and security monitoring platforms.

job.title: CNC Turner Setter Operator
job.description:
MERITUS are recruiting for a CNC Turner Setter Operator to join our Precision Manufacturing client in their growing Production team in a permanent role.

CNC TURNER SETTER OPERATOR – £16 - £18 PER HOUR – BASILDON, ESSEX – 1 STAGE INTERVIEW PROCESS - SECTOR: PRECISION MANUFACTURING - AEROSPACE COMPONENTS

An established and rapidly growing precision manufacturing company is continuing to strengthen its machining team following sustained growth across aerospace, defence and commercial engineering programmes.

As new projects continue to be secured and production expands, they're looking to welcome an experienced CNC Turner / Setter to join the business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys producing high-quality precision components, working with modern CNC machinery, and taking pride in delivering components that meet exact engineering specifications for highly regulated industries.

Working with Doosan and Haas CNC lathes, you'll play an important role in supporting production, maintaining quality standards, and contributing to the successful delivery of complex engineering programmes.

The Role

You'll be responsible for setting and operating Doosan and Haas CNC lathes to produce precision components in line with engineering drawings and quality standards. The role involves setting fixtures and tooling, monitoring tooling and surface finish, and supporting production requirements through accurate machining.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and operate Doosan and Haas CNC lathes, including Doosan 4100L, Doosan 4100 and Haas ST15Y driven tool lathes.
  • Set chucks, fixtures and tooling in accordance with setting instructions.
  • Produce precision-machined components to engineering drawing specifications.
  • Check components at the machine to ensure parts remain compliant with drawing and quality requirements.
  • Work towards agreed production targets in line with scheduled manufacturing requirements.
  • Monitor tool wear to ensure tooling remains in good condition and does not affect component quality.
  • Visually inspect surface finish to ensure quality standards are maintained.

Main Activities

CNC Lathe Operation

  • Operate Doosan and Haas CNC lathes to manufacture precision components.

Machine Setting

  • Set chucks, fixtures and tooling in accordance with approved setting instructions.

Quality Control

  • Inspect components during production to ensure they continue to meet engineering drawing specifications and quality standards.

Production

  • Support the achievement of agreed production targets in line with the manufacturing schedule.

Tooling

  • Monitor tool wear and ensure tooling remains suitable for continued production.

Surface Finish

  • Visually inspect machined parts to confirm surface finish and overall quality requirements are met.

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of a growing precision engineering business where craftsmanship, quality and continuous improvement are genuinely valued.

You'll join an experienced manufacturing team, working on aerospace, defence and commercial engineering programmes, producing high-precision components using Doosan and Haas CNC lathes.

As the business continues to secure new projects and expand its production capability, you'll have the opportunity to play an important role in its ongoing success while working in a collaborative and supportive environment.
